tools.name: get_device_location
tools.description: Read a simulated device's current city, latitude, and longitude before its weather query.
tools.description_zh: 读取模拟设备当前所在城市、纬度和经度，用于查询该设备所在地天气。控制盒=control_box；卧室设备=bedroom_sensor；客厅设备=living_room_sensor。

device.description: Exact simulated device ID: control_box, bedroom_sensor, or living_room_sensor.

tools.name: resolve_city
tools.description: Resolve a city name to an Open-Meteo location id, latitude, and longitude before a city weather query.
tools.description_zh: 将城市名称查询为天气所需的城市 ID、纬度和经度。

tools.name: get_system_time
tools.description: Read the current local system date and time.
tools.description_zh: 读取 Windows 当前本地时间。

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Read current weather using a city name and its latitude and longitude. Use resolve_city first for a named city.
tools.description_zh: 使用城市名称、纬度和经度查询实时天气；指定城市前先查询城市。
